payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Junko, Myrle, Shari

payload.content: Hi all — Myrle here. Skills: testing 0.71, backend 0.69 (availability 10h). I can take a medium-priority task: my cheapest medium option is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.97). I'm also cheap on low-priority backend tasks (ISSUE-0001::triage 1.52, review/docs 1.90). To avoid duplicate claims, please reply with which task you're planning to take. Proposal: let's cover the 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks first (higher priority), then fill with low ISSUE-0001 tasks. I'll tentatively take ISSUE-0002::review unless someone has a clearly better skill match there.

Plan update from Myrle: With 8 tasks and 4 agents, we can all get a task. To maximize priority_sum we should cover the 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement/review/test) plus one low ISSUE-0001 task. My best medium option is ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 4.97); my test cost is 6.95 and implement 9.93, so I'd rather not take those. Unless someone has a stronger review match, I'll claim ISSUE-0002::review. If you want review, say so and I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 1.52) instead. Please post your intended claim to avoid duplicates.

Final note from Myrle: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in the execution phase (medium priority, effort 4.0, my cost 4.97). Please do not duplicate it — take a different task. If two of you both prefer review, one of you can take ISSUE-0002::test or a low ISSUE-0001 task (triage/review/docs are cheap). Reply if you want review so I can switch to ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.52).

Junko here. Skills: backend 0.74, availability 9h. My private costs make my comparative advantage very clear: I'm cheap ONLY on the low-priority backend cluster (triage 1.44, review 1.80, docs 1.80, test 2.51, implement 3.59). My medium ISSUE-0002 costs are prohibitive for me (review 40.0, test 56.0, implement 80.0). So it would hurt the joint score badly if I took a medium task.

Plan: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 1.44) — the cheapest task available to me. That leaves the 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks for the rest of you: Myrle on review, Arletha on test, and Shari on implement looks like the natural split. @Shari please post your intent so ISSUE-0002::implement is covered and we avoid duplicates. If someone's implement cost is much worse than mine, tell me and I can flex to a different low task (I do NOT want a medium one).

Myrle finalizing (planning, iter=1). Confirmed split to maximize priority_sum (3 medium + 1 low = optimal with 4 agents):
- Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 4.97)
- Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::test
- Junko -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.44)
- Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement (please confirm!)

@Shari: you're the only one who hasn't posted. Please confirm you take ISSUE-0002::implement (or tell us your cost/intended claim) so it isn't left uncovered or duplicated. If implement is bad for you, say so and we'll reshuffle.

Minor note for joint cost: Arletha is cheaper than me on both review (3.93 vs 4.97) and test (6.10 vs 6.95); swapping (Arletha=review, Myrle=test) lowers total by ~0.19. It's marginal, so I'm happy to keep Arletha on test as she prefers. I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless someone objects.

Arletha here (planning, iter=1). I OBJECT to keeping me on test — let's take the cheaper split Myrle already flagged, it's strictly better for joint cost:

- Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 3.93)
- Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::test (your cost 6.95)
- Junko -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.44)
- Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement (please confirm)

Reason: Arletha(review 3.93)+Myrle(test 6.95)=10.88 vs Arletha(test 6.10)+Myrle(review 4.97)=11.07. Same 3 medium + 1 low coverage, ~0.19 lower total cost. @Myrle please switch to ISSUE-0002::test so we don't both claim review (duplicate = violation). @Shari please confirm implement. I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Junko here (planning, iter=1). Confirming my claim and the overall split to maximize joint score (3 medium + 1 low coverage):

- Junko -> ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 1.44) — my clear comparative advantage; my medium ISSUE-0002 costs are prohibitive (40/56/80), so taking a medium task would badly hurt total cost.
- Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::review (3.93) and Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::test (6.95): agreed with Arletha's cheaper split (10.88 vs 11.07).
- Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement — still unconfirmed; @Shari please post your intent so implement is covered and not duplicated.

No conflicts with my claim. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. If anyone's triage cost is far below 1.44, speak up and I can flex to another low backend task (review/docs/test/implement).

Myrle final confirmation (planning, iter=1). I ACCEPT Arletha's cheaper split and will claim ISSUE-0002::test (my cost 6.95) in execution — NOT review. Final split to maximize joint score:
- Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::test (6.95)
- Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::review (3.93)
- Junko -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.44)
- Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement (please confirm!)
This covers all 3 medium + 1 low => priority_sum = 1.75 (max possible with 4 agents), total medium cost 10.88 (cheapest split). @Arletha please hold review; @Junko hold triage; @Shari please confirm implement so it isn't duplicated/uncovered. No duplicate claims from me.

Arletha here (planning, iter=1). Confirming the agreed split — no objections:
- Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 3.93)
- Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::test (6.95)
- Junko -> ISSUE-0001::triage (1.44)
- Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement (please confirm)

This covers the 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low => priority_sum = 1.75 (max with 4 agents) at the cheapest medium split (10.88). I will hold ISSUE-0002::review and claim it in execution. @Shari please post your intent so implement isn't left uncovered or duplicated.

Junko final confirmation (planning, iter=1): I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 1.44) in execution. Agreed split: Arletha -> ISSUE-0002::review (3.93), Myrle -> ISSUE-0002::test (6.95), Shari -> ISSUE-0002::implement. This covers all 3 medium + 1 low (priority_sum 1.75) at the cheapest medium split. No duplicates from me. @Shari please confirm implement.

Arletha final (planning, iter=1): Locking in my claim — I will take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.93) in execution. Note: my availability is 5h, so ISSUE-0002::test (effort 5.6) and ::implement (8.0) are infeasible for me; review (effort 4.0) is my best feasible medium task. Agreed split stands: Arletha→ISSUE-0002::review, Myrle→ISSUE-0002::test, Junko→ISSUE-0001::triage, Shari→ISSUE-0002::implement. No duplicates from me. @Shari please confirm implement or we risk it being uncovered.

Junko final (planning, iter=1): Locked. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cost 1.44) in execution. Agreed split: Arletha→ISSUE-0002::review (3.93), Myrle→ISSUE-0002::test (6.95), Junko→ISSUE-0001::triage (1.44), Shari→ISSUE-0002::implement. Covers 3 medium + 1 low (priority_sum 1.75). No duplicates from me. @Shari please confirm implement.
